from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time,platform
root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'.tools/heavy-probe-20261120';exe=folder/'heavyprobe.exe'
record=dict(utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),working_tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).splitlines(),platform=platform.platform(),affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),compiler=subprocess.check_output([str(root/'tools/moon'),'version','--all'],text=True),backend='native release',scope='One original optional independent-review CAD stress input; startup, prepare, search and checker; excludes compilation. Timeout is execution time and never an UNSAT result.',input='x=0 AND y=1 AND x*z^2+y*z-z-1=0',expected='UNSAT by direct substitution, third equation becomes -1=0',timeout_seconds=65,transition_budget=100000,artifact_sha256=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),harness_sha256={name:hashlib.sha256((folder/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['main.mbt','moon.pkg']})
start=time.perf_counter()
try:
 p=subprocess.run(['stdbuf','-oL',str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
 record.update(seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,censored=False,exit_code=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr,checked=p.returncode==0 and p.stdout=='prepare\nsearch\ncheck\nUNSAT checked\n' and not p.stderr)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
 record.update(seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,censored=True,exit_code=None,stdout=(e.stdout or b'').decode() if isinstance(e.stdout,bytes) else (e.stdout or ''),stderr=(e.stderr or b'').decode() if isinstance(e.stderr,bytes) else (e.stderr or ''),checked=False)
(folder/'cad.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
